summary: The Republic of Uruguay filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a further issuance of 5.442% USD Bonds due 2037, adding US$399,364,067 to existing series, bringing total outstanding to US$2,399,429,163. The offering is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf registration, with bonds priced at 100.630% and expected to settle August 5, 2026. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, restructuring, or management changes. The filing is a standard capital markets transaction, so the appropriate classification is None.
